Name: Pegasus Mount
Author: SeaQueen91
Description:
This mod for Stardew Valley uses Content Patcher to transform your farm's horse into a Pegasus. It works with Stardew Valley version 1.5+.

Simply download, unzip and install it with your other Stardew Valley mods into the Mods folder.

Then enjoy riding on your majestic steed! Please let me know if you like it. Thanks!

Manifest.Name: Winged Pegasus
Manifest.Description: Changes your farm's horse into a pegasus
